# Minimal bond-type list for the t_library unit tests.
# b01 uses the Fortran 'd' exponent spelling the real library uses and b02 the
# plain one. b03 deliberately uses a non-zero exponent: 'd0' alone would parse
# to the same value even if the d->e conversion were dropped, so only a case
# like 0.3d1 actually distinguishes a working ParseFortranDouble from a broken
# one.
3
# Bond_ID  k_bond  r0_ij
 b01       10.0    0.25d0
 b02       20.0    0.5
 b03       30.0    0.3d1
